about: Gate 220 (TC-R363..365): the Opera Game reviewed, Moves view, engine line on; at plies 11 to 14 and on the analysis board after 1.d4 d5 (a position the review never searched) the engine row shows its number within 200ms and a variation within 10s - the 10s is a ceiling against 'no line at all' (the job's '20s wall clock shows no line'), not a speed target. At kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31) and 320x568 (CT_G220_GEO). NOT COVERED, and not measurable here: the depth-16 search time on his phone's WASM engine (device-only per CLAUDE.md; a CDP CPU throttle does not reach the engine's worker - ply 14 read 0.73s at 1x and 0.74s at 4x); whether depth 16 is the right depth, which is no one's change without his word.

breaks.name: searches-to-depth-40
breaks.why: the Moves-view line searches to depth 40 on a Quick review (and so misses every cached line): the search does not finish, and the row never shows a variation - the job's fear taken to its end

breaks.name: number-waits-for-the-search
breaks.why: while a live search runs, the row's stored number is blanked, so on a fresh position the player sees nothing until the engine answers

breaks.name: never-asks-the-engine
breaks.why: the line never asks the engine and reads 'Stockfish is not loaded yet' wherever the review left no cached line
